justification: Records 59 line-checked non-rules, removes typed setbacks and a non-existent 3 m separation from the granny flat warning, names the ADG sunlight criterion instead of one location-dependent figure, and labels our own estimating assumptions and survey margin as not rules.

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating?
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: confirm_and_calculate
functions.input: lot area, detected dwelling footprint, max_floor_area_m2 read from the DB
functions.output: warning text naming the stored floor area cap, no typed setbacks
functions.if_none: warning not raised when lot or dwelling area is missing

break_it.scenario: owner reads the old warning and keeps 3 m from the house
break_it.what_happens: they plan around a separation rule that does not exist
break_it.repro: run granny flat check on a small lot with a large dwelling
break_it.how: text now names the Schedule 1 setbacks and the stored floor area only

break_it.scenario: regional apartment site reads the 2 hour sun text
break_it.what_happens: the ADG figure for other areas differs, so the text misleads
break_it.repro: terrain analysis on an E or W aspect
break_it.how: text names Objective 4A-1 and says hours are set by location

break_it.scenario: yield estimate read as legal storey count
break_it.what_happens: 3 m per storey taken as a planning rule
break_it.repro: capacity engine LEP height step note
break_it.how: note says our assumption, not a rule; golden regenerated, only notes changed

post_merge.manual_verify: run one granny flat check and one capacity estimate and read the notes

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a typed rule figure is unlisted or a recorded non-rule reappears as open
